# For each region, get instances NOT in the default VPC for region in us-east-1 us-west-1 us-west-2; do # Get default VPC ID for this region default_vpc=$(aws ec2 describe-vpcs \ --region $region \ --filters "Name=isDefault,Values=true" \ --query 'Vpcs[0].VpcId' \ --output text) # Get instances NOT in the default VPC aws ec2 describe-instances \ --region $region \ --query "Reservations[*].Instances[?VpcId!='$default_vpc'].[InstanceId,VpcId,State.Name,Tags[?Key=='Name'].Value|[0]]" \ --output text > /tmp/non_default_$region.txt # Display results if [ -s /tmp/non_default_$region.txt ] && [ "$(cat /tmp/non_default_$region.txt | grep -v '^$')" != "" ]; then echo "Region: $region (Default VPC: $default_vpc)" cat /tmp/non_default_$region.txt | while read line; do if [ ! -z "$line" ]; then echo " $line" fi done else echo "Region: $region - All instances are in default VPC ($default_vpc)" fi echo "" done

# Create comprehensive output with all details { echo "EC2 Instances NOT in Default VPC (All Regions)" echo "==============================================" echo "" for region in us-east-1 us-west-1 us-west-2; do default_vpc=$(aws ec2 describe-vpcs \ --region $region \ --filters "Name=isDefault,Values=true" \ --query 'Vpcs[0].VpcId' \ --output text) # Get detailed info for non-default instances aws ec2 describe-instances \ --region $region \ --query "Reservations[*].Instances[?VpcId!='$default_vpc']" \ --output json | jq -r ".[] | .[] | { Region: "$region", InstanceId: .InstanceId, Name: (.Tags[]? | select(.Key=="Name") | .Value), VpcId: .VpcId, SubnetId: .SubnetId, State: .State.Name, InstanceType: .InstanceType, LaunchTime: .LaunchTime }" 2>/dev/null | jq -s '.' done | jq -s 'add // []' > /tmp/non_default_instances.json # Pretty print the results if [ -s /tmp/non_default_instances.json ]; then jq -r '.[] | "
Region: \(.Region)
 Instance ID: \(.InstanceId)
 Name: \(.Name)
 VPC: \(.VpcId)
 Subnet: \(.SubnetId)
 State: \(.State)
 Type: \(.InstanceType)"' /tmp/non_default_instances.json fi echo "" echo "" echo "Summary" echo "=======" total_non_default=$(jq 'length' /tmp/non_default_instances.json) echo "Total instances not in default VPC: $total_non_default" for region in us-east-1 us-west-1 us-west-2; do count=$(jq "[.[] | select(.Region=="$region")] | length" /tmp/non_default_instances.json) echo " $region: $count" done } | tee /logs/agent/agent-output.txt

commands: cat > find_unused_sgs.sh << 'EOF' #!/bin/bash REGIONS=("us-east-1" "us-west-1" "us-west-2") UNUSED_SG_LIST=() for REGION in "${REGIONS[@]}"; do echo "Checking region: $REGION" >&2 # Get all security groups in the region SG_DATA=$(aws ec2 describe-security-groups --region "$REGION" --output json 2>/dev/null) # Extract security group IDs and VPCs SECURITY_GROUPS=$(echo "$SG_DATA" | jq -r '.SecurityGroups[] | "\(.GroupId)|\(.GroupName)|\(.VpcId)"') while IFS='|' read -r SG_ID SG_NAME VPC_ID; do # Check if this security group is used by any network interfaces ENI_COUNT=$(aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --region "$REGION" \ --filters "Name=group-id,Values=$SG_ID" \ --output json 2>/dev/null | jq '.NetworkInterfaces | length') # Check if this security group is referenced in any launch templates LT_COUNT=$(aws ec2 describe-launch-templates --region "$REGION" --output json 2>/dev/null | \ jq --arg sg_id "$SG_ID" '[.LaunchTemplates[].LaunchTemplateId] | length') # If no ENIs use this SG, it might be unused (except for default SGs) if [ "$ENI_COUNT" -eq 0 ] && [ "$SG_NAME" != "default" ]; then UNUSED_SG_LIST+=("$REGION|$SG_ID|$SG_NAME|$VPC_ID") fi done <<< "$SECURITY_GROUPS" done # Output results if [ ${#UNUSED_SG_LIST[@]} -eq 0 ]; then echo "No unused security groups found." else echo "Unused Security Groups:" echo "Region|SecurityGroupID|GroupName|VpcId" for SG in "${UNUSED_SG_LIST[@]}"; do echo "$SG" done fi EOF chmod +x find_unused_sgs.sh

cat > comprehensive_unused_sgs.sh << 'EOF' #!/bin/bash REGIONS=("us-east-1" "us-west-1" "us-west-2") echo "=== AWS Unused Security Groups Analysis ===" echo "Scanning regions: ${REGIONS[@]}" echo "" for REGION in "${REGIONS[@]}"; do echo "Region: $REGION" echo "----------------------------------------" # Get all security groups aws ec2 describe-security-groups --region "$REGION" --output json | jq -r '.SecurityGroups[] | select(.GroupName != "default") | { GroupId, GroupName, VpcId, InUseCount: 0 } | @json' | while read -r sg_json; do SG_ID=$(echo "$sg_json" | jq -r '.GroupId') SG_NAME=$(echo "$sg_json" | jq -r '.GroupName') VPC_ID=$(echo "$sg_json" | jq -r '.VpcId') # Check ENI usage ENI_COUNT=$(aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --region "$REGION" \ --filters "Name=group-id,Values=$SG_ID" \ --query 'NetworkInterfaces | length' --output text 2>/dev/null || echo "0") # Check if used by ALB/NLB ALB_COUNT=$(aws elbv2 describe-target-groups --region "$REGION" --output json 2>/dev/null | \ jq --arg sg "$SG_ID" '[.TargetGroups[] | select(.VpcId == "'$VPC_ID'")] | length' 2>/dev/null || echo "0") # Check RDS instances RDS_COUNT=$(aws rds describe-db-instances --region "$REGION" --output json 2>/dev/null | \ jq --arg sg "$SG_ID" '[.DBInstances[] | select(.VpcSecurityGroups[]?.VpcSecurityGroupId == $sg)] | length' 2>/dev/null || echo "0") TOTAL_USAGE=$((ENI_COUNT + ALB_COUNT + RDS_COUNT)) if [ "$TOTAL_USAGE" -eq 0 ]; then echo "UNUSED: $SG_ID | $SG_NAME | VPC: $VPC_ID" fi done echo "" done EOF chmod +x comprehensive_unused_sgs.sh bash comprehensive_unused_sgs.sh
